title: The Prophet had informed that at the end of time people will not feel
body:
comfortable and in peace in their homes anymore
The Prophet had informed that at the end of time people will not feel
comfortable and in peace in their homes anymore, even it is like a castle,
and they must leave, they must go out in the street. But they are not
reaching peace there either, rather it is getting worse.
Before there used to be dergahs, tekkes, camis and misafirhanes of the 41
Tariqats, and people could go there. Nowadays they go to coffee-shops,
kahvehanes... The Naqshibandi-gathering is heavy, that is why they are not
coming. But in old times people used to find peace and happiness for their
soul. But they brought people away from worshipping, and therefore the souls
of people are in unrest. They go to cinema happily, but come out heavy.
In the dergahs people were trained and educated. They used to write over the
door: Adab, ya Hu! ('Remember your manners..!') Nowadays no one is respecting
the other one anymore, but now the angels will hit them! The soul of a believer
is taken easily, but the soul of a disbeliever slowly and painfully.
To stay at home means safety, to go out in the street means danger. Don't
walk around unnecessarily. You can be at peace even with many people in one
room. With the electric fitna started. If everyone would stay in their home,
fitna would reduced to half or even more. A believer finds happiness in his
home. But Shaitan brought mankind down- may his Sultanate be destroyed!
All coffee-houses are unnecessary- they are the source of hasad (jealousy).

Until they are closed, people will not find their peace, wasting of money will not stop,
and the nation will not get up again. This is important to know.
Ya Muhauli hauli wa-l ahwal, hauli halina ila ahsani hal!
Lefke - 19.11.2001
